parameters.name: pathId
parameters.description: The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line. Must belong to a process-path family declared in this deployment's process-path catalogue (ADR-0012; today the fleet's sortable-fc topology declares the pick/pack/rebin/slam families, each optionally carrying a "-"-delimited station/zone suffix, e.g. pick-a or pack-station-1). The write endpoints (receiveChargeForecast, commitShiftPlan, enqueueWorkUnit) reject ids outside the declared families with `400 unknown-path-id`; read endpoints surface a missing pool/projection as `404` instead.

parameters.name: cutoffAt
parameters.description: Optional RFC3339 CPT cutoff timestamp. When supplied, the response additionally reports remaining admission capacity for this path correlated against this cutoff, and a `PathCapacityChanged` event is published (ADR-0018). Must be non-empty when present — `?cutoffAt=` (present but empty) is a `400`, not "omitted".
